name: iina-streams
description: Twitch and YouTube streaming plugin for IINA with draggable glassy chat overlay, read-only Twitch chat, and automatic VOD replay.

scripts.install-local: npm run build && rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.colliderli.iina/plugins/local.iina.streams.iinaplugin" && cp -R dist/release/streams.iinaplugin "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.colliderli.iina/plugins/local.iina.streams.iinaplugin"
